summary: Templates composes published producers at scaffold time and packs FS.GG.Workspace.Template; it does not vendor Rendering runtime or the SDD CLI. The repository is not source-empty: a nonpackable net10.0 F# ProviderTool implements composition, reference publication and feed occupancy helpers. Source includes console, web, Python, Fable bindings/game and Governance template content, provider descriptors, opt-in examples and original-archive composition tests. The protected source version is 0.19.0 and its current owner plans record coherent publication, while installed outcomes remain scoped by journey. The older broad overview is retained as superseded; package-id rename still requires explicit uninstall/install because dotnet new update does not cross IDs.
title: Template composition includes compiled qualification tooling
